Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added armoury-section fullness detection. AutoBuy now skips a gear section once normal inventory is full and the matching armoury section is also full, covering Main Hand, Head, Body, Hands, Legs, Feet, Off Hand, Ears, Neck, Wrists, and Rings.
